findings: SOURCE-DIFF-AND-VARIANT-FIDELITY: crates/mori-core/src/stage/report.rs defines a pure, deterministic, I/O-free outcome_report(Result<StageOutcome, StageRejection>) -> serde_json::Value helper and crates/mori-core/src/stage/mod.rs re-exports it without altering any stage types, constants, admission rules, or cost/digest logic. All three result variants preserve exact field names and sources: Waiting emits status='waiting', advanced, segment, continuation, attempted, committed (from continuation.logical.committed), and residual; Complete emits status='complete', segment, attempted, committed, and residual; Err(rejected) emits status='rejected', error (rejected.error), attempted (rejected.attempted), and committed (rejected.committed). All three STAGE_LABELS ('qualification': 'local-reference-stage', 'authentication': 'none', 'consumption': 'untracked') are unconditionally inserted into the top-level JSON object.

CLI-CONSUMER-AND-IO-PRESERVATION: In crates/mori/src/commands/simulate.rs, print_stage_result preserves ExitCode::SUCCESS for Ok(_) and ExitCode::FAILURE for Err(_), delegates envelope construction to mori_core::stage::outcome_report(result), and prints via unchanged super::core_io::print. The pub(super) fn print_stage_report helper remains byte-identical for inspect.rs, and run_resume/run_stage_start bounded readers and decoders are unchanged. In crates/mori/src/commands/test/stage_test.rs, run_case replaces the duplicated private report(...) helper with stage::outcome_report(...) while preserving 1 MiB JSON/source/scenario readers, 64 KiB event decoding, zero-work rejection wrapping, and in-memory actual continuation chaining.

TEST-VS-GOLDEN-ORACLE-FIDELITY: crates/mori-core/tests/stage_reports.rs executes actual stage::load, stage::start, and stage::resume calls across the two normal cases in mori-tests.json (two-deliveries with logical_cap=16 and quoted-fee with logical_cap=null), chaining only actual returned waiting continuations and never deserializing continuations from expected fixtures. All six invocations (two-deliveries-start, two-deliveries-observed, two-deliveries-approved, two-deliveries-complete, quoted-fee-start, quoted-fee-complete) assert both full serde_json::Value equality and canonical pretty-byte equality (serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&actual) + '\n' == expected_text.as_bytes()) against the frozen R3 fixture copies in crates/fixtures/core-stage-reports/ (FREEZE.sha256 digest 885663843203a1fe2f7820884d17f56e98b5dd10a3bbee654829ac649187203e). False guard observation in approval-false.json is verified to return non-advancing Waiting (advanced=false, segment=null, attempted=2, committed=5) with an unchanged continuation equal to before_observation.

SOURCE-SECURITY-ASSESSMENT: The candidate (commit e2c3d80736c764313df2554b372fdde945f72fde, tree 61bc8233eb3c0ce421ac5a80e4112eed952925a6, base 7a9ab2477f74debf868524c6c26c22ddbfc6d1be) introduces no unsafe code, FFI, process execution, network access, filesystem writes, build.rs scripts, proc-macros, or link-section/constructor attributes. Compile-time include_str! in stage_reports.rs resolves strictly to crates/fixtures/core-stage-reports/ within the repository. Existing include! macros in crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/ remain confined to unselected lib cfg(test) modules.
